evidence_summary: The prose says “impossible” but the example is marked ?, which CGEL uses for questionable grammaticality (p. xii), not ∗. Ch. 17, p. 1550, lists the combination without qualification: “Here and there can occur as complement to a preposition: in here, from/to there, and so on.”
finding: Low to medium confidence. The prose and the mark disagree about strength, and Ch. 17 treats to there as an ordinary combination. The hedge “generally” and footnote 5 soften the claim, which limits the conflict.
